title.narrative: Advancing People Centered Justice and Security Systems in Asia and the Pacific

description.narrative: Advancing People-Centred Justice and Security Systems in Asia and the Pacific (2026–2028) is a regional initiative led by UNDP’s Bangkok Regional Hub to strengthen inclusive, accountable, and resilient justice systems across the Asia-Pacific region. Responding to stagnating rule of law indicators, widening justice gaps, and emerging challenges from digital transformation, climate impacts, and political fragility, the project focuses on improving access to justice for marginalized groups and restoring public trust in institutions.Through regional convening, technical advisory support, research, and south–south cooperation, the initiative aims to build justice and security systems that are people-centred, gender-responsive, and adaptable. It delivers five key outputs: enhancing judicial integrity and service delivery; advancing gender-responsive justice and women’s judicial leadership; strengthening rights-based digital and AI governance in justice systems; improving judicial capacity for environmental and climate justice; and ensuring crisis-responsive justice mechanisms. Together, these efforts contribute to SDG 16 and UNDP’s Regional Programme Outcome 3 by supporting justice systems that are trusted, inclusive, and resilient.
